summary.headline: Afternoon sun, 1 to 4 hours a day
summary.subline: From about 13:30 until about 16:45. Most in March, least in June.

advice:
Verdict: Afternoon-only sun year-round, strongest in March with 3.8 hours and weakest in June with 1.2 hours.
Blocked by: distant towers to the west-southwest and your potted olive tree.
Good for: sunset sitting, heat-tolerant herbs, drying laundry
Not for: full-sun vegetables, solar panels, all-day sunbathing
Tip: Move pots out of the sun path in winter and add a light shade for summer afternoons.
